note: Independent audit of RFC 7947 Section 2.1: "A route server MUST accept all UPDATE messages received from each of its clients for inclusion in its Adj-RIB-In." (followed by: "These UPDATE messages MAY be omitted from the route server's Loc-RIB or Loc-RIBs, due to filters configured for the purpose of implementing routing policy."). Summary row RFC7947-2.1-1 quotes the MUST verbatim at [MUST] with no annotation. Production path: on ingress denial (or mixed-UPDATE denied announcements via filter_ordered.go::ingressPolicyWithdrawals) for an rs-client peer (reactor_notify.go::retainDeniedIngress: hasPeer && src.RSClient), enqueueFilteredIngress queues withdrawals on the ordinary update rail followed in FIFO order by the original pre-policy UPDATE bytes on update-filtered (EventKindUpdateFiltered), skipping recentUpdates caching, RS fast path, AIGP and EventBus; bgp-adj-rib-in is the sole subscriber, storing ImportFiltered:true and FilterStep independently of RPKI Ineligible, while walkReplayRoutes, replayPathCommand, routeEligible and applyToInstalled withhold ImportFiltered entries unconditionally and session_prefix.go bounds unique retained keys in offered mode. Positive (TestRFC7947ClientDeniedUpdateRetainedInAdjRIBIn) drives real TCP sessions in lowLiveRouter with the registered bgp-adj-rib-in plugin across both ingress-denial rails -- LoopIngress (loop-denial: AS_PATH [65002, 65000] under FinalAccept) and peer-policy-chain (import-policy-denial: clean AS_PATH [65002] under FinalReject) -- asserting exact pre-policy AttrHex (and NLRIHex in loop-denial), filtered:true, filter-step, status counts (total-routes=2, filtered-routes=1) and withholding on both ReplayRoutesCommand and ReplayPathCommand while keeping an accepted rs-client control route (203.0.113.0/24) stored and replayable. Negative (TestRFC7947OrdinaryPeerDeniedUpdateAbsentFromAdjRIBIn) uses the identical fixture, loop-denied UPDATE and live control route, flipping only source.RSClient to false, and asserts absence from show bgp adj-rib-in and replay withholding (role confinement matching RFC 7947's negative polarity). Inputs isolate the exact rule with well-formed attributes and valid first AS; both tags carry revert discrimination records (enqueueFilteredIngress positive, retainDeniedIngress negative), and semantically removing enqueueFilteredIngress fails positive require.Len(rows, 1) while dropping the RSClient gate in retainDeniedIngress fails negative requireAbsent. Minor scope notes: newFilteredReceivedLive grants bgp-adj-rib-in wildcard "*" rather than an explicit update-filtered token (validated separately by TestReceiveGrantAcceptsUpdateFilteredToken); loop-denial asserts FilterStep NotEmpty rather than pinning "loop", and import-policy-denial omits a direct NLRIHex check (unambiguous via len(rows)==1 + ReplayPathCommand); mixed UPDATEs, denied replacements, Loc-RIB/wire exclusion, RPKI independence and unique-retained prefix bounds are covered in untagged sibling tests; OutcomeWithdraw (e.g. RFC 9234 OTC treat-as-withdraw/leak) follows ingressChainWithdrawal rather than update-filtered.
